ratings.name: Safe
ratings.description: Little to no danger is expected under normal conditions.

ratings.name: Caution
ratings.description: Some danger is present; ordinary care and preparation are advised.

ratings.name: Unsafe
ratings.description: Danger is likely, and unprepared travellers should avoid the area.

ratings.name: High
ratings.description: Serious threats are common; only capable, well-prepared groups should proceed.

ratings.name: Very High
ratings.description: Severe and potentially lethal threats are expected.

ratings.name: Extreme
ratings.description: Survival is unlikely without exceptional preparation, skill, or protection.

ratings.name: Insane
ratings.description: The danger exceeds ordinary mortal limits and should almost always be avoided.

ratings.name: Legendary
ratings.description: A legendary threat capable of overwhelming even the greatest heroes.
